identifications.note: unchanged, but its price is sharpened: net chirality is impossible on ANY closed oriented 3-manifold (PD + chi=0, generalising B1086 past doubles) and impossible in the cusped ABELIAN sector (Alexander reciprocity), so any h^1 that is to count generations must come from a rank>=3 non-self-dual system -- which cannot factor through SL(2) since every Sym^n is self-dual.

claim_one_line: WHERE NET CHIRALITY CAN LIVE. MAIN_GOAL JOIN 1 question 1. (1) THE CLOSED WALL IS GENERAL: for ANY closed oriented 3-manifold, PD (h^i(V) = h^(3-i)(V*)) plus chi = 0 plus h0(V) = h0(V*) = 0 for irreducible V forces h1(V) = h1(V*) IDENTICALLY -- so B1086's 'as PD forces on any closed double' is a special case, the wall is dimension 3 plus CLOSEDNESS, and any closed assembly is vector-like whatever its h1. (2) THE CUSPED ABELIAN SECTOR IS WALLED TOO, and not by closedness: the Fox derivatives of m004's relator in the 1-dim rep are +-Delta(t)/t with Delta = t^2-3t+1 whose roots are phi^2 and phi^-2 (product 1), Delta is RECIPROCAL (verified symbolically), its vanishing locus is symmetric under t -> 1/t which is exactly V -> V*, so h1(C_t) = h1(C_(1/t)) at every value including the Alexander root where h1 jumps; Alexander reciprocity is a theorem for ALL knots so the abelian sector never carries net chirality. (3) HENCE RANK >= 3 AND NOT THROUGH SL(2), since every Sym^n of SL(2) is self-dual (verified) -- and the corpus's whole SL(n) tower is the PRINCIPAL family (B71 builds SL(3) via sym2(), B153's rows are the principal spectrum), so the corpus's own SL(n) work cannot answer this. (4) THE SEARCH REDUCES TO ONE BRANCH ALREADY REALISED: B102 proves every irreducible SL(3) figure-eight character is Case I (trA = trA^-1, self-dual by definition) or the trB = trB^-1 = 1 branch, with '0 neither' verified (33 + 5 + 0 at n=40); in the 8 trace coordinates B102's genuine non-Sym^2 components W1 = (1,q,q,1,p,1,1,p) and W2 = (p,1,1,q,1,q,p,1) are NON-SELF-DUAL for p != q, and B102 realised both as EXPLICIT SL(3) reps. THE DECIDING COMPUTATION, named and small: h1(V) vs h1(V*) on W1/W2 -- differ means the cusped manifold carries net chirality and JOIN 1 q1 resolves for the cusped object; agree means the wall extends past closedness AND past the abelian sector and the generation count cannot be a net-chirality count on this manifold at all. SCOPE: B71 records these coordinates are the FIBER group, not the knot group, and the fiber<->knot dictionary is a separate identification -- which extension is meant is part of the deciding computation, not assumed. SHARPENED AT B1290 (2026-09-06): the CUSPED room this arc left open is now stated as a condition -- with net chirality = chi(M, d+M) (cited, not derived on main), chi(m004) = 0 and chi(T^2) = 0 give net chirality = -chi(d+M), so the cusped case is ZERO for ANNULAR d+M and nonzero only if d+M carries DISCS or CORNERS. Not a reversal: the verdict stands and the room is now checkable. See ADDENDUM_2026-09-06_B1290_the_cusped_statement.md.
